keyEvents.text: Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match (Bayer 04 Leverkusen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig).
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Tidiam Gomis replaces Brajan Gruda because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1, RB Leipzig 0. Patrik Schick (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Miguel Gutiérrez with a cross.
First Half ends, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1, RB Leipzig 0.
Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2, RB Leipzig 0. Miguel Gutiérrez (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a fast break.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Andrija Maksimovic replaces Rômulo.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Nicolas Seiwald replaces Ezechiel Banzuzi.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Robert Andrich replaces Equi Fernández.
Neil El Aynaoui (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Christian Kofane replaces Patrik Schick.
